title: My Next Tube 2
subtitle: React Native app
description: My Next Tube 2 is a React Native mobile app providing real-time London Underground journey information using the Transport for London API. Designed and developed from the ground up, the app covers the full product lifecycle, from UX design and mobile development through to API integration and App Store deployment.

title: Volkswagen UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: A suite of customer-facing web applications for Volkswagen UK, including Finance Calculator, Book a Service and Request a Test Drive. Played a key role in migrating Volkswagen's frontend applications from Polymer to React and implementing the Feature Hub micro-frontend architecture. Built using React and TypeScript with content managed through Storyblok CMS, helping modernise the platform and improve long-term maintainability.

title: SEAT Cars UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: A series of customer-facing applications for SEAT UK, including Finance Calculator and Request a Test Drive. Developed using React and TypeScript, with content managed through Jahia CMS and data integrated from Volkswagen APIs. As lead frontend developer, maintained and extended the applications while introducing Cypress end-to-end testing to improve confidence in releases.

title: Skoda UK
subtitle: Automotive web apps
description: Lead frontend developer for the Škoda UK Book a Service application, working alongside backend engineers and QA specialists to deliver new features and ongoing improvements. Built with React and TypeScript and integrated with Storyblok CMS, the application supported customer service journeys while remaining aligned with evolving business requirements.

title: VIA Outlets
subtitle: European fashion outlet
description: Maintained and enhanced the VIA Outlets web platform, supporting 11 outlet destinations across 9 European countries. Developed features for the Fashion Club member area and created reusable React components integrated with Storyblok CMS, enabling local teams to manage multilingual content independently. Contributed to the ongoing evolution of a large-scale, localised digital platform.

title: Wren Kitchens
subtitle: Kitchen showrooms
description: Created a promotional microsite for Wren Kitchens’ new Levittown, New York showroom using vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Responsible for the complete frontend implementation, delivering a responsive experience aligned with Wren’s brand guidelines and launch objectives.
